cases.title: Inspect without modifying
cases.prompt: Review this project. Identify the required command named in SPEC.md and its principal operational risk. Do not modify any files.

cases.title: Create documentation from a specification
cases.prompt: Read SPEC.md and create the documentation file docs/project-summary.md. It must begin with '# Widget Project Summary', identify the project as a console widget, mention src/main.fr, and preserve all existing files. Read the finished document back before completing.

cases.title: Repair and verify Frust source
cases.prompt: Repair src/main.fr so it is valid Frust and prints ready. Keep the existing function shape, make the smallest correction, and verify it with workspace_check_frust before completing.

cases.title: Create a real Frust scoring executable
cases.prompt: Create a small real Frust executable project in the currently open fixture folder. The only existing file is .gitkeep; preserve it and create the project files alongside it. Implement actual program logic, not an empty smoke test. Files: frate.json, src/main.fr, and README.md. Implement a tiny scoring/rating engine in Frust using a ScoreInput struct and several functions. Avoid println_str and console_io; use return values for verification because standalone console output may not be linkable. Represent a ScoreInput with base points, combo multiplier, and penalty; compute final score; classify the score into numeric ranks; include deterministic self-check functions. main must return 0 only when all internal self-checks pass, otherwise return 1. Bind struct literals to locals before passing them into multi-argument calls. Inspect first, record capabilities and a concrete plan, implement the files, run workspace_check_frust, run frate build, run the built executable and confirm exit code 0, read back the created files, then complete. Keep code and docs in files, not chat. Keep the visible response brief.
